release and re-sign preserve an unrostered gap
season rollover, zero appearances and historical-only membership are independent
snapshots never invent transaction dates; conflicts and uncertain evidence remain unresolved
receipt replay, supersession and actual database knowledge cutoffs preserve old evidence
game-level historical team evidence is unchanged by later roster transactions
frozen unlocked and locked pools retain all members, positions, teams and optional On Slate
On Slate false does not remove otherwise eligible players
legacy locked or populated slates are explicit review cases, never reconstructed
incomplete catalogs, wrong Group and a late failure leave no partial header/membership
concurrent roster writes replay once and frozen-pool writers serialize under the slate lock
NFL K limits and synthetic team defenses use existing IDs and frozen canonical slots
RLS, grants, restrictive identity FKs and caller permissions fail closed
Allgeier documented -1 and all three signed yard categories persist; counts stay nonnegative

repeated identical NFL facts append zero; receipt replay is immutable and exact
out-of-order, tied conflicting and invalid late rows reject atomically including receipt and head

concurrent NFL same-receipt replay and overlapping workers produce one transition each
legacy positive/zero rows and IDs survive new corrections without rewriting history
rollback after new usage refuses without deleting any historical record
